# {{PRODUCT_NAME}}

Generated by Niwar DevForge using the `web-next-auth` blueprint.

## Development

1. Set `DEVFORGE_PRODUCT_PUBLIC_ORIGIN` to the exact browser origin.
2. Set `DEVFORGE_PRODUCT_BACKEND_API_BASE_URL` to the backend API `/api/v1` prefix.
3. Install dependencies, then run `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build`.

The reusable browser credential boundary comes from `@niwar-devforge/web-bff-core`; browser session revalidation comes from `@niwar-devforge/web-session-core`. Backend bearer credentials are never intentionally exposed to browser JavaScript.

`DEVFORGE_PRODUCT_TRUST_INGRESS_CLIENT_IP=1` is deployment-only and may be enabled only when the product is served through HTTPS and the BFF is unreachable except through an ingress that removes/overwrites `X-DevForge-Ingress-Client-IP` on every external request.
